text: Follow-up for the Resource Hub access slice you are integrating (docs/resource-hub/LOCKED_GATE_ADMISSION_NOTE.md, on fable/recruiter-resource-hub-20260906). I verified the founder package's three claims against the real source and they hold: MEMBER_SESSION_READ_PATHS has /partner/links,/partner/me,/partner/dashboard and no Resources entry; layout.tsx:386 exempts only links and dashboard; auth-return-to.ts:23 omits Resources. CORRECTION to my b1b41c80 handoff: the download door does NOT belong in downstreamMemberGuardedDownload - that predicate (index.ts:496) matches only the signed /api/research/documents/<uuid>/download?exp=&sig=<43> URL and would never match. The Resource Hub download is bearer-authorized with no signature, so it fits memberSessionRoute (index.ts:617) as an anchored shape ^/partner/resources/([^/]+)/download$ with canonicalUuid on the id, alongside the existing customer-account/documents/:id precedent, plus /partner/resources as an exact entry in MEMBER_SESSION_READ_PATHS. Both stay behind 'if (bearer && memberSessionRoute(...))'. Admission is not permission: the doors are registered with the injected requireMember and every handler runs withPartner, which resolves the partner from the authenticated member only; the denial matrix (no bearer 403, no partner record 404, wrong audience 404 not 403, suspended/terminated empty, draft/unpublished/withdrawn 404, unknown id 404 with no ledger row) is pinned by portal-routes.test.ts and service.test.ts and does not depend on the wall. I edited none of the three files. Please re-run the partner portal + resource-hub suites and the locked-gate probe on the combined tree.
